Building a CRM needs a blueprint understanding, and our AI builder helps clients to understand which and how to build the best CRM
Press enter or click to view image in full size

https://saascrm.site/blueprintHello folks
Today’s post is about something we’ve been shipping quietly on SAASCRM.site: the AI Builder — a free planner that helps you design your CRM in about two minutes.
No signup. No sales call. Just describe what you’re building, and get a clear plan matched to the SaaSCRM template.
What is the AI Builder?
The AI Builder lives at /blueprint. Think of it as a CRM architect in your browser.
You tell it:

• Business type (SaaS, agency, recruiting, real estate, and more)

• Team size

• Backend plan (prototype, Supabase, Firebase, existing API…)

• Launch target (prototype, MVP, or production)

• Features you need — Leads, Pipeline, Invoices, CMS, Analytics, and so on

• A short note on what you’re building
It returns a blueprint you can actually use — not a vague “AI summary.”
What does it provide?
After you generate a plan, you get:

• Overview — what’s already covered by the template vs what needs custom work

• Page map — the CRM screens you should ship first

• Recommended stack — frontend and backend direction that fits your answers

• Timeline — realistic estimates for prototype, frontend, backend, and production

• Cursor prompts — copy-paste prompts tailored to the SaaSCRM project rules

• Build CRM — a path to start from the template (or generate a small free starter)
In short: less guessing, more shipping.
How to use it (simple)

• Open Plan your CRM

• Pick your business type, team size, backend, and target

• Tap the modules you need

• Write one sentence about what you’re building

• Hit Generate free CRM blueprint

• Review the tabs — especially Pages, Timeline, and Cursor prompts
That’s it. You can run a few plans per hour for free and refine as you go.
Build CRM with our template
The blueprint is the map. The template is the foundation.
Once you like your plan:

• Buy the source template and open it in Cursor

• Paste the generated prompts to customise modules, branding, and workflows

• Explore matching screens in the live demo
👉 Build CRM with our template — one-time purchase, lifetime updates.
Or start free first: Open the AI Builder.
Plan first. Customize next. Ship faster.
Cheers,
Shrey
